glosses: To make sure and secure; ensure.

examples.text: I assure you that the program will work smoothly when we demonstrate it to the client.
He assured of his commitment to her happiness.

glosses: To make sure or certain of something (usually some future event or condition).

examples.text: I use an alarm clock to ensure that I get up on time.

glosses: To make a living; earn money for necessities.

examples.text: It is difficult to provide for my family working on minimum wage.

glosses: To act to prepare for something.

examples.text: provide against disaster.

glosses: To establish as a previous condition; to stipulate.

examples.text: The contract provides that the work be well done.
I'll lend you the money, provided that you pay it back by Monday.

glosses: To give what is needed or desired, especially basic needs.

examples.text: Don't bother bringing equipment, as we will provide it.
We aim to provide the local community with more green spaces.
Humans provided the animals with food and protection in exchange for which the animals provided the humans their milk, eggs, and—yes—their flesh.

glosses: To furnish (with), cause to be present, supply.

examples.text: Rome […] was generally well provided with corn.

glosses: To make possible or attainable.

examples.text: He provides us with an alternative option.

glosses: To foresee, to consider in advance.

examples.text: We have not been covetous, honourable fathers, to change, neither is it now any new lust that alters our affection, or old lothing, but those needful jealousies of state, that warn wiser princes hourly to provide their safety, and do teach them how learned a thing it is to beware of the humblest enemy; much more of those great ones, whom their own employed favours have made fit for their fears.

As for those that will (by faults which charity hath raked up, or common honesty concealed) make themselves a name with the multitude, or, to draw their rude and beastly claps, care not whose living faces they intrench with their petulant styles, may they do it without a rival, for me! I choose rather to live graved in obscurity, than share with them in so preposterous a fame.
